Divine_10_desc: Becomes independent species, genetic code perfectly aligned, all gene effects doubled.
Divine_11_desc: Corruption auto-dissipates, all attributes greatly increased, gene avatar fights independently.
Divine_12_desc: Immortal body, personal dimensional space projection auto-activated.
Divine_13_desc: Solidifies eternal dimensional space, wields complete gene origin, cross-save existence.

ds_tier_01_awakened_desc: Gene lock first unlocked, ability gene fragments begin to express, initially perceive own element fluctuations, can weakly guide ability energy, starting the first step of element knowledge accumulation.
ds_tier_02_initiate_desc: Ability energy forms stable storage cycle in body, begins to understand gene-energy operation rules, unlocks basic abilities like energy bolt/energy shield, somatic cells begin self-healing enhancement.
ds_tier_03_refined_desc: Ability gene expression intensity significantly increased, deeply understand element properties, somatic cells deeply adapt to ability energy, unlock body enhancement/healing light, ability consumption reduced, nerve reaction speed accelerated.
ds_tier_04_transformed_desc: Gene-level directed transformation, master element evolution laws, chromosome structure fully optimized, gain element resistance, cell aging speed greatly delayed. [Monolith evolution + random good traits + immune to new mutations]
ds_tier_05_controller_desc: Proficient in fine expression regulation of ability genes, can finely control ability energy output, turbulence index growth halved, ability precision greatly improved. [System differentiation starting point]
ds_tier_06_domain_desc: Understand gene-element field theory, open exclusive ability domain, self gene expression amplified in domain, enemy gene expression suppressed. [Combat power watershed]
ds_tier_07_materialized_desc: Master ability gene materialized expression, spiritual will extremely stable, immune to low-level mental interference, ability can condense into physical form for physical attack, normal attack probability triggers energy blade.
ds_tier_08_lawbearer_desc: Proficient in gene expression rules, can locally affect cell physiological constants, energy attacks with rule penetration effect, nearby low-level enemies cannot use skills. [Rule suppression]
ds_tier_09_originator_desc: Return to gene essence, understand DNA origin operation, absorb surrounding enemy energy every year, energy utilization extremely optimized, ability consumption greatly reduced, energy recovery doubled, almost no energy waste. [Origin absorption]
ds_tier_10_realmbreaker_desc: Insight into gene dimension structure, break space dimension boundaries, can resonate with environmental energy from distance, space rifts appear in domain for dimensional attacks, full map ability user position perception. [Space tear]
ds_tier_11_sanctuary_desc: Ability genes highly purified, can autonomously dissolve turbulence index, condense element avatars for remote combat.
ds_tier_12_ascended_desc: Form perpetual gene expression closed loop, turbulence index stops growing, open personal dimension space (dimension projection), body gains super regeneration ability, immortal body. [Dimension projection + immortality]
ds_tier_13_truegod_desc: Solidify eternal dimension space, control complete ability gene rules, can create energy life forms in dimension space, can grant divine blessings to subordinates. [Cross-save interconnection + global influence + divine blessing grant]
ds_era_dominator_trait_desc: The sole dominator of the True God Era, receives full blessing of heaven and earth laws. Attack and defense greatly increased. This trait is unique, only one person owns it at the same time, automatically transfers to new dominator when dominator falls or is overthrown.
ds_status_energy_shield_desc: Ability energy automatically forms a shield. Auto-obtained at Tier 2 Resonator
ds_status_body_boost_desc: Ability energy continuously strengthens the body. Auto-obtained at Tier 3 Enhancer
ds_status_energy_weapon_desc: Ability energy condenses into a physical weapon. Auto-obtained at Tier 7 Materializer
ds_sect_leader_desc: Highest leader of the ability organization, masters all ability graph archives, has the power to accept/expel/appoint, management+diplomacy+military comprehensive improvement.
ds_sect_deputy_desc: Second-in-command of the ability organization, assists the leader in coordinating the overall situation, acts on behalf of the leader when absent, can manage captains and senior members, management+diplomacy improvement.
ds_sect_elder_desc: Regional manager of the ability organization, manages multiple captain teams, can teach high-level abilities to senior and above members, diplomacy+management+cultivation improvement.
ds_sect_cadre_desc: Grassroots manager of the ability organization, leads teams to execute tasks, can manage senior and regular members, management+combat improvement.
ds_sect_elite_desc: Senior member of the ability organization, experienced and capable, can access complete organization ability graph, combat+cultivation greatly improved.
ds_sect_member_desc: Regular member of the ability organization, can learn basic organization abilities, enjoy organization resource bonuses, cultivation speed +3%.
ds_sect_probation_desc: New member of the ability organization, in probation period, can only learn the most basic abilities, cultivation speed +2%, promoted to regular member after passing assessment.

ds_sect_guest_desc: External invited advisor of the ability organization, non-regular member, enjoys organization resource usage rights, can participate in organization decision discussions, improved diplomacy.

age_ds_truegod_description:
In this era, genetic laws are completely rewritten, and the descent of a True God marks a brand new starting point on the path of evolution. The world is bathed in sacred genetic energy, and the DNA of all living beings trembles slightly.

Gene locks loosen accordingly, and the barriers of evolution are no longer insurmountable. Psions can feel the dormant genetic sequences within their bodies awakening, and new abilities sprout like spring buds breaking through the soil.

When people look up at the sky, their hearts are filled with reverence and hope. They understand that a being beyond the mortal realm is watching over this world, guiding the direction of evolution.

In the darkest moments, the genetic light of the True God shines like a lighthouse, forever guiding life to explore the ultimate mysteries of evolution.
